questions.stem: Which of the following happens during the recovery period after exercise?

options.text: Heart rate immediately returns to resting level
Lactic acid is converted to glucose in the liver and oxygen stores are replenished
The body switches entirely to anaerobic respiration
Muscles begin to produce more lactic acid

questions.explanation: During recovery, the body repays the oxygen debt by breaking down lactic acid in the liver, replenishing oxygen stores in haemoglobin and myoglobin, and restoring ATP and creatine phosphate levels.
